selection_metrics.stable_proxy_rule: NDVI > 0.6 in both dates and abs(delta) < 0.08; not a verified control ROI

selection.selection_reason: Training-only clear full-crop QA, target >=25 pixels, exact annotation-date post observation, nearest clean pre observation, NDVI drop >=0.15; stable seeded event hash selects distinct groups.
selection.selection_bias: Strong-signal, clear-image curation pilot; not a representative accuracy/evaluation sample. Source collection balance is not seasonal balance. Metrics do not establish visible clearing or no-change truth.

pair.label_interpretation: New annotated loss between observations; zero is not verified no-change

interior_rule: One-pixel 3x3 binary erosion of anchor-specific new-loss reference
empty_interior_action: Explicit manual pixel selection or rejection required; no boundary fallback

control_proposal.search_rule: No catalogue geometry within 20 m; clear endpoints; NDVI > .6 both and absolute change < .10

catalogue_exclusion_rule: Every cleaned catalogue geometry, all dates and provenance classes, buffered 20 metres and burned all-touched

timeline_window.interpretation: Local windowed observation evidence; not a global first-clearing claim

limitations: Strong-signal, clear-image training pilot is not a representative benchmark.
Numerical control proposal is not verified unchanged forest.
Timeline is limited to local same-year observations within the declared 45-day window.
Annotation image date is not exact felling date; explicit visible-state review is required.
